raw_response.message: Context Y, signals A=0, B=1, C=1. The elicited table rates A weaker in Y (0.42, 90% CI 0.10-0.80) and B and C stronger (0.62 each, 0.25-0.92). These are wide, uncertain estimates. In our one Y record (round 3), A=1 and B=C=0 with truth 0, so B and C matched and A did not. That fits the table but is a single case.
